visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair in a ponytail is sitting at a wooden table in a living room. She wears a blue V-neck sweatshirt over a white shirt. On the table are keys, a small plush toy keychain, and a silver smartphone. She gestures with her hands towards the camera, looking cheerful. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of her left wrist as she lifts her arm to reveal a black circular smartwatch. The background is a blurred living room scene. (3) The character is now outdoors in a park with green trees and playground equipment. She is performing leg stretches and lunges on a rubberized mat surface while wearing the smartwatch. (4) Close-up screen recordings of the watch interface display various fitness tracking features, including activity logs, heart rate, and sleep data menus. (5) A series of quick montages shows the woman in different states: sleeping on a couch, waking up with a energetic pose, eating chips from a red bag, and exercising in the park. (6) Several product beauty shots appear against a neutral studio background, showcasing the smartwatch in multiple colors: pink, white, and black. (7) A close-up shot shows the character using the watch to make a contactless payment at a POS terminal. (8) The woman returns to the indoor living room setting, standing in front of a white brick-patterned wall and a sofa. She speaks directly to the camera, clapping and gesturing enthusiastically as the video concludes.
